description: This file is a markdown document outlining the interface, capabilities, operation, and detailed specifications for the HDMIOutput HAL interface. It provides high-level overview, functional details, implementation requirements, capability profiles, and operational diagrams for managing HDMI outputs within a platform.

classes.name: Capabilities
classes.description: Describes the supported video formats, pixel formats, color spaces, HDR support, and other capabilities of an HDMI output port.

classes.name: HDCPStatus
classes.description: Enumeration representing the HDCP authentication state.

classes.name: HDROutputMode
classes.description: Enumeration for different HDR output modes.

classes.name: SPDSource
classes.description: Enumeration identifying the type of SPD (Source Product Description) InfoFrame sources.

classes.name: VIC
classes.description: Enumeration for HDMI Video ID Codes representing supported video modes.

classes.name: Property
classes.description: General key-value property interface for setting or querying HDMI output configuration.

methods.name: getCapabilities
methods.description: Returns the capabilities of the HDMI output port, including supported formats, resolutions, HDR modes, etc.

methods.name: setProperty
methods.description: Configures the HDMI output with specific properties such as VIC, HDR mode, AFD, etc.

methods.name: start
methods.description: Initiates HDMI signal output after configuration.

methods.name: stop
methods.description: Stops HDMI output and releases resources.
